title: [AgentX GB200] restore the Kimi-K3 18-point arm: telemetry gate on 8 completed points, engine failures on 8 / 恢复 GB200 Kimi-K3 的 18 点 arm：8 个跑完的点被功耗闸门拦下，8 个在引擎内失败
body:
The GB200 Kimi-K3 AgentX curve lost 18 of its 31 points on 2026-08-21 (a three-key sweep replaced the whole curve). [Run 35492708340](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492708340) re-measured all 31 points from #3287 head `5338791`; 19 jobs failed, for three different reasons. The two that account for 18 of them are now root-caused, and both fixes are on #3287.

## What is missing

`kimik3-fp4-gb200-dynamo-vllm-agentic` covers concurrency 1–384 across `agg-tp16-latency`, `agg-tep16-balanced`, `agg-dep16`, `agg-dep16-vllm-simple-offload`. AgentX resolves one curve per hardware, so a partial GB200 selection replaces the published points instead of extending them. The three mooncake keys are healthy (13 published points with valid power). No power target depends on this issue.

## What run 35492708340 actually showed

19 failed jobs:

- **10 completed the benchmark and failed only publication validation** (`sample_gap_exceeded` → `package_recompute_invalid`): TP16 c1/c2/c4/c8, TEP16 c16/c24/c32, vllm-simple c192, and tp8pp2-mooncake c72/c96.
- **8 died of an out-of-memory allocation in the engine**: DEP16 c32/c64/c96/c128/c256 and vllm-simple c128/c256/c384 — every point of the two recipes that set `max-num-batched-tokens: 16384`, and no point of any other recipe.
- **1 was a client-side abort**: tp8pp2-mooncake-mtp c16 ended in `ProfileAborted` with `measurement_window_incomplete`, and its 16 logs contain no OOM and no worker crash. It is an aiperf-side abort, not an engine failure, and is the one failure in this run without a fix attached.

Corrections to the earlier version of this issue:

- Not "all 16 completed points of this arm OOM". Of the arm's 16 points, 8 ran to completion and were dropped at the power gate; 8 died in the engine.
- The DEP16 c32 OOM is not a ~20 MB allocation against 22–29 MB free. It is a 3.64 GiB allocation against 3.50 GiB free, and it happens 24 minutes into the run, not at startup. See below.
- `endpoint_http_error` is present in every one of the 29 power manifests of the run, valid or not, so it is not the discriminator; `sample_gap_exceeded` is. It is the deduplicated record of the collector's first polls racing the exporter container start (connection refused) and is informational only.
- `885d227` (500 ms / 1 s) is an ancestor of the sweep head `5338791`, so the sweep already ran with it and it is not the fix for these failures.

## Root cause of the 10 gated points

Two mechanisms, both visible in the `power_audit_*` artifacts:

1. **Head-node exporter latency tail (8 points, all 500 ms / 1 s lanes).** Every miss is on the first node of the allocation, the one also running the Dynamo frontend, NATS/etcd, the AIPerf client and the srtctl collector. The passing 1000 ms / 2 s lanes on the same fleet record `max_scrape_duration_seconds` of 1.2–1.6 s and zero misses; at a 1 s request timeout that tail becomes hundreds of timed-out scrapes per job (TP16 c1: 217 misses on cn13 in-window, exporter log shows 242 `write: broken pipe` late responses, all from the collector's own node). The collector is fixed-cadence, so the "sleeps after each scrape" premise behind 500/1 was also wrong. Fix: keep the four lanes on the fleet-standard 1000 ms / 2 s (in #3287, `e318545`).
2. **Whole-collector stalls (tp8pp2-mooncake c72/c96, 1000 ms / 2 s).** No per-host misses; instead 10 and 2 cycles where all four hosts land 3.3–20 s late at the same instant, so the srtctl collector thread itself paused on the head node.

Restoring the cadence does not by itself republish either group. `_check_coverage` voids a window as soon as one device's largest gap passes `MAX_SAMPLE_GAP_SECONDS`, applied to a single excursion with no budget, so one late scrape still discards every GPU of the job — and whether a point publishes depends on whether its excursion lands inside the measurement window or in warmup. [SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm#23](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm/pull/23) replaces that single threshold with a hard ceiling plus a fractional budget, which absorbs both the latency tail and the shorter collector stalls while still rejecting a collector that actually stopped. #3287 carries the matching consumer change and pins the producer commit until it merges.

## Root cause of the 8 engine deaths

FlashInfer's MXFP4 MoE workspace (`FP4BlockScaleLauncher::prepare_moe`) is allocated per forward, outside the memory profiler's budget, and scales with the batch's token count. At `max-num-batched-tokens: 16384` it requested 3.64 GiB against 3.50 GiB free — 177.50 of 184.00 GiB already in use — and killed rank DP1/TP3/EP7 24 minutes into DEP16 c32. The surviving ranks then hung in a collective until `ProcessGroupNCCL::HeartbeatMonitor` aborted the job five minutes later, which is why these read as mid-run engine deaths rather than allocation failures.

TP4/DP4 keeps four times the non-expert weights per GPU that a TP16 recipe does, so the headroom the larger chunk needs is not there. `agg-tep16-balanced` and `agg-tp16-latency` run the same kernel at 8192 and complete, as do all five tp8pp2-mooncake recipes; 16384 appears only on the two recipes that died. Fix: both DEP16 recipes drop to 8192 (#3287, `1731889`), which leaves KV cache capacity untouched.

## What restoring the arm needs

- [x] #3287: 1000 ms / 2 s cadence on the four lanes (`e318545`)
- [x] Sample-gap budget so a single late scrape stops voiding the window (srt-slurm#23, pinned from #3287 `b63c1768`)
- [x] DEP16 c32–c256 and vllm-simple c128–c384: `max-num-batched-tokens` 16384 → 8192 (#3287, `1731889`)
- [ ] Full 31-point GB200 re-sweep on #3287 proving both fixes on hardware — neither has been exercised on GB200 yet
- [ ] tp8pp2-mooncake-mtp c16 `ProfileAborted`: unexplained, retry and see whether it recurs

## 中文说明

GB200 Kimi-K3 AgentX 曲线在 2026-08-21 丢失了 31 个点中的 18 个（三个 key 的 sweep 替换了整条曲线）。[Run 35492708340](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492708340) 基于 #3287 head `5338791` 重测了全部 31 个点，19 个 job 失败，原因分三类。其中占 18 个的两类都已定位，修复都在 #3287 上。

### 实际结果

- **10 个点 benchmark 跑完、只在发布校验失败**（`sample_gap_exceeded` → `package_recompute_invalid`）：TP16 c1/c2/c4/c8、TEP16 c16/c24/c32、vllm-simple c192、tp8pp2-mooncake c72/c96。
- **8 个点在引擎内因显存分配失败而死**：DEP16 c32/c64/c96/c128/c256 与 vllm-simple c128/c256/c384——恰好是设置了 `max-num-batched-tokens: 16384` 的两个配方的全部点，其余配方一个都没有。
- **1 个点是客户端中止**：tp8pp2-mooncake-mtp c16 以 `ProfileAborted` 结束，伴随 `measurement_window_incomplete`，其 16 份日志中既无 OOM 也无 worker crash。这是 aiperf 侧的中止，不是引擎失败，也是本次运行中唯一还没有对应修复的失败。

对本 issue 早期版本的更正：

- 不是"这条 arm 跑完的 16 个点全部 OOM"——16 个点里 8 个跑完后被功耗闸门丢弃、8 个在引擎内死亡。
- DEP16 c32 的 OOM 不是"约 20 MB 的分配对上 22–29 MB free"，而是 3.64 GiB 的分配对上 3.50 GiB free，且发生在开跑 24 分钟之后，不是启动阶段。详见下文。
- `endpoint_http_error` 出现在该 run 全部 29 个功耗 manifest 中（含通过的点），只是采集器首轮轮询早于 exporter 容器就绪的去重记录，不是判别条件，`sample_gap_exceeded` 才是。
- `885d227`（500 ms / 1 s）已是 sweep head `5338791` 的祖先，这次 sweep 就是带着它跑的，它不是这些失败的修复。

### 10 个被闸门拦下的点的根因

1. **头节点 exporter 响应长尾（8 个点，全部是 500 ms / 1 s lane）。** 所有 miss 都在分配的第一个节点上，该节点同时运行 Dynamo frontend、NATS/etcd、AIPerf 客户端和 srtctl 采集器。同一集群上通过的 1000 ms / 2 s lane 记录到 `max_scrape_duration_seconds` 为 1.2–1.6 s 且零 miss；1 s 超时把这条长尾截成每个 job 数百次超时（TP16 c1：窗口内 cn13 miss 217 次，exporter 日志有 242 条 `write: broken pipe` 迟到响应，全部来自采集器所在节点）。采集器是固定节奏的，500/1 所依据的"每次抓取后再 sleep"前提也不成立。修复：四个 lane 回到集群标准的 1000 ms / 2 s（#3287，`e318545`）。
2. **整个采集器停顿（tp8pp2-mooncake c72/c96，1000 ms / 2 s）。** 没有按主机的 miss，而是 10 次和 2 次四台主机同时迟到 3.3–20 s 的周期，说明头节点上的 srtctl 采集线程本身停顿。

只恢复节奏并不能让这两组点重新发布。`_check_coverage` 只要某个设备的最大间隙超过 `MAX_SAMPLE_GAP_SECONDS` 就判废整个窗口，且该阈值针对单次抖动、没有任何预算，因此一次迟到的 scrape 仍会作废该作业所有 GPU 的数据——一个点能否发布，取决于它的抖动落在测量窗口内还是落在 warmup 里。[SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm#23](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm/pull/23) 用"硬上限 + 按比例预算"取代这个单一阈值，既能吸收响应长尾和较短的采集器停顿，又仍能拦住真正停止工作的采集器。#3287 带有对应的消费端改动，并在其合入前先 pin 生产端提交。

### 8 个引擎内死亡的根因

FlashInfer 的 MXFP4 MoE workspace（`FP4BlockScaleLauncher::prepare_moe`）按每次 forward 分配，不在内存 profiler 的预算内，且大小随 batch 的 token 数增长。在 `max-num-batched-tokens: 16384` 下它申请 3.64 GiB，而当时只剩 3.50 GiB free——184.00 GiB 中已占用 177.50 GiB——在 DEP16 c32 开跑 24 分钟后杀掉了 DP1/TP3/EP7 这个 rank。其余 rank 随后卡在集合通信上，直到五分钟后 `ProcessGroupNCCL::HeartbeatMonitor` 终止整个作业——这也是它们表现为运行中途引擎死亡、而非一次分配失败的原因。

TP4/DP4 每张卡驻留的非专家权重是 TP16 配方的四倍，没有更大 chunk 所需的余量。`agg-tep16-balanced` 与 `agg-tp16-latency` 在 8192 下运行同一个 kernel 且能跑完，五个 tp8pp2-mooncake 配方同样如此；16384 只出现在死掉的那两个配方上。修复：两个 DEP16 配方降到 8192（#3287，`1731889`），不影响 KV cache 容量。

### 恢复需要做什么

- [x] #3287：四个 lane 采用 1000 ms / 2 s（`e318545`）
- [x] 采样间隙预算，使单次迟到的 scrape 不再判废整个窗口（srt-slurm#23，由 #3287 `b63c1768` pin）
- [x] DEP16 c32–c256 与 vllm-simple c128–c384：`max-num-batched-tokens` 16384 → 8192（#3287，`1731889`）
- [ ] 在 #3287 上跑完整的 31 点 GB200 sweep，在硬件上验证这两项修复——两者都尚未在 GB200 上验证过
- [ ] tp8pp2-mooncake-mtp c16 的 `ProfileAborted`：原因未明，重试观察是否复现

title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 SGLang AgentX on H200 results from AIPerf and from Site
body:
https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/33038487711/job/98406760985#step:5:215 shows 4 GPUs and also the SGLang command line is setup for 4 GPUs, but the site https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/inference/qwen-3-8-flash-next?g_model=Qwen3.8-Flash-Next&g_rundate=2026-09-15&i_metric=y_outputTputPerGpu&i_xmode=interactivity&i_gpus=h200_sglang&i_optimal=0&i_best=0&i_conclabel=1&i_seq=agentic-traces&i_dates=2026-08-27 shows 16 GPUs.

Also, AIPerf shows about 217 tok/s output per user at P90 and the site shows 13.

I may be misunderstanding the site and AIPerf of course, but decided to notify anyway just in case there's some error somewhere, sorry if this is a mistake on my part.

Thanks a lot for the site and the results!

title: [WIP] refactor/cleanup repo
body:
## Repository refactoring progress

Tracks merged work related to repository cleanup, shared Python tooling, workflow simplification, and recipe organization.

### Merged: core refactoring

- [x] #2897 — Deduplicate benchmark internals.
- [x] #2901 — Simplify changelog orchestration and strengthen tests.
- [x] #2903 — Share AgentX matrix generation.
- [x] #2911 — Move matrix tooling and schemas into `infx`.
- [x] #2940 — Centralize result processing in `infx` and speed up tests.
- [x] #2941 — Move power engines into `infx`.
- [x] #2947 — Share eval artifact selection rules.
- [x] #2948 — Move eval row construction into `infx`.
- [x] #2987 — Share result topology and GPU-count logic.
- [x] #3003 — Move AgentX processing into `infx`.
- [x] #3015 — Retain selected eval results during reuse deduplication.
- [x] #3018 — Centralize eval result selection in `infx`.
- [x] #3019 — Plan sweeps in-process through `infx`.
- [x] #3022 — Migrate remaining Python tools into `infx`.
- [x] #3029 — Unify matrix expansion.
- [x] #3086 — Standardize srt-slurm v2.2.1 and shared launcher integration.
- [x] #3094 — Unify benchmark workflow inputs.
- [x] #3103 — Migrate and organize SRT recipes. Stacked on and integrated into #3086.

- [x] #3168 — Package `infx`, centralize locked uv dependencies with a 12-hour cutoff, and resolve trusted tooling from current `main`.
- [x] #3180 — Unify GitHub requests through `gh api` and reject malformed or incomplete listings while preserving workflow tokens and local authentication.

- [x] #3193 — Share eval artifact loading and validation across collection, reuse, and Klaud while preserving selection and failure ordering.

- [x] #3152 — Replace manual synthetic-acceptance settings and the YAML injector with native SRT overrides and automatic golden-curve selection; includes documented acceptance corrections.

### Merged: tests, CI, and cleanup

- [x] #2799 — Remove tautological tests and document test-quality expectations.
- [x] #2898 — Consolidate Klaud guidance and progress reporting.
- [x] #2943 — Standardize CI on uv and harden workflow role checks.
- [x] #3089 — Remove redundant power tests while retaining exporter coverage.
- [x] #3093 — Collapse Chinese translations in GitHub templates and guidance.
- [x] #3101 — Prune structural, tautological, and duplicate tests.
- [x] #3125 — Reuse one checklist verdict comment; carry-forward policy refined in #3145.
- [x] #3126 — Update one sweep visualizer comment and prevent stale runs from replacing newer links.
- [x] #3140 — Add Ruff linting and formatting for `infx`.
- [x] #3141 — Remove obsolete tests, eval aliases, and runtime patches; centralize runtime settings.
- [x] #3143 — Remove obsolete CodeQL guidance from ingest recovery instructions.
- [x] #3145 — Harden pipeline edge cases, trim weak tests, and retain sign-off across verified admin updates.
- [x] #3153 — Strengthen Ruff checks and clean up `infx` implementations.
- [x] #3154 — Skip unnecessary sign-off runs; superseded by ownership-based scoping in #3155.
- [x] #3155 — Consolidate CI workflows and scope CODEOWNER sign-off.
- [x] #3157 — Preserve complete Klaud baselines and fill candidate slots past duplicates or capacity claims.
- [x] #3161 — Enforce strict Zizmor checks for workflow changes and harden workflow execution.
- [x] #3162 — Handle duplicate GitHub file entries without weakening incomplete-diff checks.
- [x] #3163 — Read current target-branch CODEOWNERS so existing PRs receive ownership fixes.
- [x] #3164 — Simplify sign-off verdict output and distinguish rejection from missing verification.
- [x] #3177 — Pin E2E benchmark and eval jobs to the resolved measured commit. Stacked on and integrated into #3168.
- [x] #3179 — Fail closed on workflow-statistics collection errors, share GitHub pagination, and remove PyGithub.

- [x] #3192 — Add `/use <run_id>` as the preferred sweep-reuse command, preserve legacy syntax, and protect unrelated comment reactions.

- [x] #3197 — Document advisory CODEOWNER verification after removing its required-status gate; preserve checklist feedback and human review requirements.

- [x] #3199 — Remove advisory sign-off status publishing and carry-forward bookkeeping; retain checklist verification and one comment tied to the assessed commit.

- [x] #3201 — Delete unused `utils/klaud` compatibility wrappers; current callers already use `infx.klaud`.

- [x] #3202 — Share sweep-run lookup between staging and reuse, move staging into `infx`, preserve command behavior, and consolidate behavioral tests.

- [x] #3212 — Scope workflow credentials by purpose, use the built-in token for checkout and run statistics, and retain the existing Hugging Face secret.

- [x] #3208 — Support Klaud fail-fast final sweeps while retaining exact-head, successful-run, and complete-coverage validation.
- [x] #3233 — Keep the complete frozen Klaud baseline in the PR body, remove duplicate baseline comments, and retain recovery of the old format.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

本清单记录已合并的仓库重构、共享 Python 工具、工作流简化和配方整理工作。

本次补充的已合并工作包括：折叠 GitHub 模板与指南中的中文翻译；复用单一签核结论和 sweep 可视化评论，防止旧运行覆盖新链接；清理过时的 CodeQL 恢复指南；修复流水线边界情况、删减低质量测试，并在已验证的管理员更新后保留签核。

签核范围检查的后续修复包括：正确处理 GitHub 返回的重复文件记录，同时拒绝不完整的差异列表；读取目标分支最新的 CODEOWNERS，使已有 PR 也能获得归属修复；精简结论输出，明确区分验证被拒绝与尚需验证。早期的签核延续和跳过规则已由清单中注明的后续 PR 调整。

新增的已合并工作：#3157 保留完整的 Klaud 基线，并在遇到重复候选或容量占用时继续补齐候选名额；#3161 为工作流变更启用严格的 Zizmor 检查并加固执行边界；#3168 将 `infx` 打包，使用 uv 统一锁定依赖并实施 12 小时发布冷却期，可信工具统一取自当前 `main`；#3177 固定 E2E 基准测试与评估使用的测量提交，已随 #3168 集成。

#3179 修复运行统计在请求失败时仍报告成功的问题，统一使用共享 GitHub 分页逻辑，并移除 PyGithub 及不再使用的依赖。

#3180 统一通过 `gh api` 发送 GitHub 请求，拒绝格式错误或不完整的列表，同时保留工作流 Token 和本地认证方式。

#3192 新增首选扫描复用命令 `/use <run_id>`，保留旧命令，并保护无关评论上的表态。

#3193 统一收集、复用校验和 Klaud 的评测工件读取与校验，保留结果选择规则和错误处理顺序。

#3197 说明 CODEOWNER 自动验证在移除必需状态门禁后仅供参考，保留清单反馈与人工审阅要求。

#3199 移除参考签核的状态发布及批准延续逻辑，保留清单验证和注明实际评估提交的单一评论。

#3201 删除未使用的 `utils/klaud` 兼容入口，现有调用均已直接使用 `infx.klaud`。

#3202 统一暂存与扫描复用的源运行查询，将暂存逻辑移入 `infx`，保留命令行为并精简行为测试。


#3212 按用途隔离工作流凭据，checkout 和运行统计改用内置令牌，并保留现有 Hugging Face secret。

#3152 使用原生 SRT overrides 和自动 golden 曲线选择，替代手动 synthetic acceptance 设置与 YAML 注入器；同时包含 PR 中明确说明的 acceptance 修正。

#3208 支持 Klaud 的 fail-fast 最终完整 sweep，同时保留精确 head、运行成功和完整覆盖校验。

#3233 将完整冻结基线仅保留在 Klaud PR 正文中，移除重复的基线评论，并兼容旧格式的恢复流程。

</details>

title: [Question]  Is hardware contribution to the official CI cluster supported?
body:
## Overview
I am developing InferenceX recipes on my fork repository. However, the HCU hardware I am using is not yet supported.

## What I can provide
Hygon DCU

## Questions
1. What are the requirements to add self-hosted hardware into the official CI pool?
2. What standardization work is required for the environment?
3. Is there any hardware/network/security checklist I need to follow?
4. What is the evaluation and onboarding process?

Thanks.
